references.purpose: The role/job-role/feature-filtered area computation every surface reads.

risk: Permissions. The menu is a data surface: a restricted link serialized to someone who cannot open it leaks the app's structure and breaks trust in the shell. The conservative direction is structural: areas, tabs and profile links are computed on the server from role, job-role screens and shown features, and only the filtered result is serialized. The change is presentational — no page content, money rule or deep URL moves — but it touches every desk layout, so a missed layout shows stale tabs rather than wrong data.
